text: 1. "Application Form for Foreign Students Studying at Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine" 2. Scanned copy of passport (valid for 6 months from the date of submitting the application). 3. Highest educational qualification and/or degree certificate, as well as scanned copies of academic transcripts: Applicants are required to submit scanned copies of their graduation certificates and/or degree certificates; if the applicant is currently enrolled in school, they must also provide a scanned copy of the certificate issued by their school confirming their enrollment status. 4. Copy of HSK certificate. 5. Electronic photo: Color 2-inch bareheaded ID photo. 6. Economic evidence. 7. Certificate of No Criminal Record. 8. Health examination certificate. 9. Study Plan in China (written in both Chinese and English, approximately 800 words).
